data.body: Fixed: removed set -uo pipefail from the sourced library (libraries must not impose shell options on callers) and guarded BASH_SOURCE[0] with ${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0} fallback to prevent 'parameter not set' errors when sourced in non-bash contexts (e.g. zsh) under nounset. Added test-planning-config-source.sh with 6 tests covering: source under set -u, source under strict mode, flag default false, flag true when configured, nounset not imposed on caller, BASH_SOURCE unset guard.
